text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day at training…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Phew… That's it for my cool down. Thanks for today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty, I gotta hurry up and get ready.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Actually… The doughnut place in front of the station is having an all-you-can-eat special today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I had a light lunch in preparation for it, and now I'm so hungry I could eat an elephant, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna eat so many doughnuts that my belly practically explodes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm a little concerned about putting on weight, but I should be fine if I work really hard during tomorrow's training!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec… Oh no! I just remembered—tomorrow's the scrimmage!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I totally forgot about it… Way to go, doughnut brain!
choice_data_list: Maybe you should go easy on the doughnuts.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: No, it's okay. I'm sure I'll be fine! I had a really good training session today!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: If anything, I should eat a lot of doughnuts to help get me all pumped up! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm off! I'll see ya tomorrow, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day, Special Week has a terrible showing and loses the scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniffle…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I return to my room in the evening, I hear the faint sound of someone crying.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm such an idiot! Sob…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eek! T-Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry… I lost at the scrimmage, and I know it's because I ate too many doughnuts.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I wasn't crying because I was frustrated by my loss.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I was crying because I was angry at myself for taking the race too lightly.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I thought I had become a serious racer when I put on my signature racewear for the first time, but…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I forgot how it felt then… And now I'm the biggest idiot in the world!
choice_data_list: Let's take this experience and learn from it.
I went too easy on you as well.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay! From now on I'll treat all races seriously, even scrimmages!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I don't ever wanna feel this way again. And I don't want to disappoint you either, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've cried enough, so all that's left now is to run like there's no tomorrow! In fact, I'm gonna do some solo training right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Thank you! Let's give it our all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She regains her original enthusiasm and the sounds of her footsteps echo in the tranquil evening air around the track.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer, if I ever sound like I'm not taking things seriously…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Or if I forget what it was like when I first put on my signature racewear, then I hope you put me back on track!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Great! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty! Now I'm gonna go run and get my motivation back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is a good reminder to Special Week that it's no easy task to make your dreams come true.
